notes: ROLLED BACK 2026-08-10: v1.1.6 was published and then withdrawn WITHOUT any device installing it. Reason is not the firmware content but the OTA delivery path: a device running 1.1.5 has ~109.7 KB free heap at the boot OTA check while MIN_OTA_HEAP demands 110 KB, so the install defers on every boot. The daily check does not install, it REBOOTS the device to install at boot, so a published newer version makes every device reboot nightly, burn one of its three per-version attempts each time, and permanently refuse that version after three nights, at ~70 s of lost corrections per reboot. Reverting the version stops that immediately. The binary below is deliberately LEFT AS IS (it is the 1.1.6 image) so a cached manifest can never be paired with a different binary; only the version is reverted, and update.c installs strictly newer versions only. The 1.1.6 content (mode-base undulation fix) is correct and bench-proven; it needs a delivery fix first: do not book an attempt when the heap pre-check defers, and free the AP/DHCP/DNS heap before the boot install.
